frozen_scope.endpoint: n3=4158, equivalently no induced triangular prisms

complete_fixed_core_reduction: Choose two permutations pairing the 60 allowed edges in fibre 0 with those in fibres 1 and 2.
Require the three cross-fibre concurrence matrices to equal the off-diagonal blocks of B B^T.
Require the per-column mixed-equation cut d(b)>=0.
Choose a simple symmetric 8-regular H and enforce the exact xy and yy equations above.
The resulting 3+36+60 block matrix satisfies A^2=12I-A+2J and is a full srg(99,14,1,2) certificate.

component_balance.block_moments: For z_y=|b_y intersect C|, sum_y z_y=30m and sum_y z_y^2=15m^2.
component_balance.component_shape: Every X component has m vertices in each fibre and 3m total.

6.orientation_constraints: The 3-by-3 zero-diagonal count matrix indexed by (double coordinate, zero coordinate) has every row and column sum 12.

component_balance.equality_consequence: All 60 blocks satisfy z_y=m/2; hence every component parameter m is even.
component_balance.m_equals_2_exclusion: A connected cubic triangle-free graph on six vertices is K_3,3, whose same-side nonedges have three common X-neighbors, contradicting mu=2.

partition_coupling.4+4+4: Per block the only component-pattern combinations are balanced AAA, aligned ABB, or balanced BBB, where A is a permutation of (2,0,0) and B of (1,1,0).
partition_coupling.4+8: The m=8 pattern is the coordinatewise complement 2-z of the m=4 pattern.
partition_coupling.6+6: The two m=6 patterns are coordinatewise complements.

component_balance.per_fibre_moments: For z_iy=|b_y intersect (C cap X_i)|, sum_y z_iy=10m, sum_y z_iy^2=m^2+8m, and sum_y z_iy z_jy=2m(m-2) for i!=j.

forced_equations.xx: B B^T = 12I - A_X + 2J - R R^T - A_X^2
forced_equations.xy: B H = 2J - (I + A_X) B = (J/3 - I - A_X) B

hypotheses: A_X is the cubic triangle-free 36-vertex core induced by a base triangle.
Its three 12-point fibres have quotient matrix J_3.
B is a binary 36-by-60 matrix with two ones per fibre in every column.
H is a simple symmetric 60-by-60 adjacency matrix completing the SRG block equations.

per_column_cut.consequence: Every coordinate of d(b) is nonnegative.
per_column_cut.inside_B: A_X[B] has maximum degree at most one.
per_column_cut.outside_B: No outside X vertex has three neighbors in B.

pointwise_triangle_transfer.definition: e_y=number of A_X edges induced by block b_y

spectral_transfer.H_connected: Yes: the displayed spectrum has exactly one eigenvalue 8.
spectral_transfer.component_parameter: c=number of connected components of A_X
spectral_transfer.row_space_action: H on im(B^T) has eigenvalue 8 and eigenvalues -1-lambda for every non-quotient, non-component-3 eigenvalue lambda of A_X

limitations: The restricted core fixes one derangement and three within-fibre one-factors.
The 151712 survivors are individual columns, not a simultaneous 60-column design.
No compatible H, full graph, endpoint exclusion, or upper-bound improvement is supplied.
The spectral-transfer theorem is derived here but is not self-promoted to VERIFIED.
